name: Frankie
self_text: I am an Egyptian in my late 20s. I studied engineering and I am currently studying programming. I enjoy sketching buildings in my spare time because it helps me relax. I can meet online. I am free Sunday morning or Sunday afternoon. I work best with working through problems together. I need occasional short exchanges. I am looking for someone to explain things to me.

requests.request_text: I need us to overlap on online. Ideally, you are available Sunday afternoon or Sunday morning, but no big deal.
